title: Child Link in Gohma's room, slingshot and sticks
notes: GohmaStage is the rush room (the boss fight without the dungeon). Gohma_DefeatBoss is the flag the autotest scenarios clear.

The boss is made alive as docs/dungeons-boss.md (the boss set table) has it: the shared quest Get_StoneOfForest is put back to its step DefeatBoss and the boss's Bools to their before values (the intro's BossIn flag is left as the save has it). The save must be of the right age and have the dungeon's keys.
